t: Introduction and overview — Forrestal-class Aircraft Carrier
name: Introduction and overview — Forrestal-class Aircraft Carrier — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Forrestal-class Aircraft Carrier
description: Introduction and overview of the Forrestal-class Aircraft Carrier: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Forrestal class — four ships — were the first U.S. supercarriers: 60,000 tons with angled decks and steam catapults, the template for all later American carriers. Forrestal suffered the disastrous 1967 fire off Vietnam. The class served through the Cold War into the 1990s. Baseline facts: First U.S. supercarriers; 4 built; 60,000 tons; angled deck and steam catapults..
